title: Plane carrying Maury Island slag explodes, killing two officers

tellings.quote: >> So, they get back on their plane and they're going to fly back to their base. Their plane explodes in midair.

plain: In 1947, two military officers are said to have flown back to their base from Washington State carrying slag, a rocky waste material, tied to a strange incident at Maury Island, and their plane exploded in midair, killing them both. A researcher named Peter Levenda tells the story, without naming a source, in an account that involves a man named Fred Crisman: "they get back on their plane... Their plane explodes in midair." Told this way, the deaths hint that the material was more dangerous, or more sensitive, than anyone admitted.
